method.capture_hook: capture.py registers forward hooks on model.model.layers[i]; model.model is called directly. Stored vectors are decoder-block outputs before the enclosing model's final normalization.
method.rsa: Spearman correlation of upper-triangle cosine similarities; raw-normalized, globally feature-centered then row-normalized, or separately language-mean-centered then row-normalized.

bootstrap.scope: D7-to-D8 change in globally centered lexical-pooling E5 RSA; percentile interval; pairs are recomputed within each resampled set of 200 concepts.

qwen.hook_relation: capture.py hooks model.model.layers[i] outputs; model.model applies final norm after the decoder-layer loop, so saved block states, including the last block, are pre-final-norm.

mistral7b.hook_relation: capture.py hooks model.model.layers[i] outputs; model.model applies final norm after the decoder-layer loop, so saved block states, including the last block, are pre-final-norm.

olmo7b.hook_relation: capture.py hooks model.model.layers[i] outputs; model.model applies final norm after the decoder-layer loop, so saved block states, including the last block, are pre-final-norm.

method.partial_rsa: Rank both RDM vectors; first subtract means within each unordered language-pair stratum; then residualize same-concept status, absolute and mean character length, and absolute and mean captured-model subword count. Pearson-correlate residual ranks. Descriptive only.

pair_classes.cross_language_distinct_concept: different languages and different concept IDs

method.character_count: Python Unicode code-point length of frozen word string; not grapheme-cluster length.
method.subword_count: number of captured tokenizer lexical-span token indices; counts are model/tokenizer-specific.
